title: Diverse, but Divisive: LLMs Can Exaggerate Gender Differences in Opinion Related to Harms of Misinformation
findings: The paper does not report any specific findings related to religion. Religion was included as an example of a demographic category in the experimental prompts given to human annotators and the LLM, but the analysis and results focused exclusively on gender differences.
